ios.desc:
With My Links you can manage all your links stored in Linkwarden from the ease of your phone or tablet. My Links has been created to offer the user a beautiful and simple interface, following Apple's design guidelines, while offering the same functionalities as the Linkwarden web application.

With My Links you can:
- View all your links
- Create new links and edit existing ones
- Upload PDF files and images
- Pin links to the dashboard
- Access the preserved formats of each link (webpage, reader mode, PDF file and image)
- View the links in each category
- Create and edit categories
- View links for each tag
- Create new links from the share menu when sharing an URL
- Supports servers that use mTLS (requires iOS 18 or greater)

All this while preserving your privacy, because My Links does not share your personal information with anyone, nor does it share information you have stored in Linkwarden.

My Links is also available for macOS, if you have a Mac, download it and enjoy it on your Mac too!
